title: user.merged
description: Consumed from stapel-auth. An anonymous guest account was absorbed into an existing account; the guest row ceases to exist. Search re-indexes every document whose owner_key is the guest onto the survivor — table and engine both, since rewriting only the row would leave the engine's copy owned by an id that can no longer sign in. Deliberately not a source re-pull: the source may not have processed its own merge yet, and ingest treats a document missing from the source's answer as a delete. Contract owned by the emitter.
